messages:
Maria K.: thinking out loud — can we add a lightweight version-negotiation layer to the proxy so clients that talk older api shapes get a graceful bridge + telemetry hooks?
Vikram S.: yes. similar to the shim proxy idea but focused on observability. key is we need hooks that let us see: attempted negotiation, fallback used, and correctness regressions.
Cheng L.: +1. also we should avoid any expensive per-request transforms. prefer header-based handshake first, then opt-in body transformations for sampled traffic.
Samir P.: what fields do we add to telemetry? request_api_version, negotiated_version, shim_applied (bool), shim_type, sampling_bucket, semantic_check_passed (bool).
Maria K.: that covers it. OpsBot: note recorded: incident_telemetry_event created for negotiation experiments.
Vikram S.: rollout plan idea: 1) header-only detection (no transform) with telemetry flags, 2) enable non-destructive transforms for 1% sampled traffic, 3) increase sampling and enable full transform+response validation, 4) enable auto-fallback/policy.
Elaine R.: need a config toggles matrix per-tenant. Dedicated customers should be able to opt out. Also add a per-route safe-mode that returns 412 instead of auto-mutation if mismatch.
Cheng L.: sample config (proxy):
```
versions:
  supported: [v1, v2, v3]
  negotiation_header: X-Redwood-API-Version
  sampling:
    enabled: true
    percent: 1
    buckets: ["control","shim-a","shim-b"]
  behavior:
    v1->v3: shim-v1-to-v3
    fallback: return-412
```
Samir P.: telemetry event prototype (log line):
`negotiation event: tenant=acme, req_ver=v1, offered_ver=v3, negotiated=v3, shim=shim-v1-to-v3, sampled=true, check_pass=true`
Maria K.: testing: we need golden prompt suites per major endpoint so we can compute semantic_check_passed. compare embeddings diff + deterministic token checks for streaming.
Vikram S.: agree. also add a safelist of prompts that are excluded from sampling for privacy/regulatory reasons.
Elaine R.: operational alarms: spike in shim_applied or drop in semantic_check_passed should open a page and auto-roll back to header-only. set thresholds: shim_applied >5% suddenly OR semantic_check_passed < 98% for 10m.
Cheng L.: implementation notes: prefer async validation pipeline — return transformed response but run validation downstream; if validation fails, emit telemetry and increment failure counter and consider rolling back via feature-flag.
Samir P.: can we piggyback existing rollout infra? use flags-service to control percent and buckets, and metrics via rollout-metrics pipeline.
Maria K.: yes. next steps: Vikram to sketch proxy change + header parsing RFC, Cheng to draft telemetry schema, Samir to wire sampling into flags, Elaine to write ops runbook and rollback thresholds.
Vikram S.: I'll put a short RFC up today, include POI for dedicated/private opt-out hooks.
OpsBot: reminder: @channel design sync tomorrow 10:30 to review RFC draft. :spiral_calendar: :loud_sound:
Maria K.: thanks all. keeping this lightweight is crucial — no silent mutations without trace. :thumbsup:
